Amid progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, economic activity and employment are strengthening, and the FOMC’s average-inflation-targeting framework, ongoing asset purchases, and explicit forward guidance remain growth supportive. The small increases to IOER and the ON RRP rate are technical adjustments within the floor system, not a signal of tightening. The May 2021 Financial Stability Report, however, highlights elevated asset valuations and risk appetite, high business leverage and lingering CRE stress, and structural funding vulnerabilities in certain nonbank intermediaries, even as banks remain well capitalized and market functioning has improved. Net: constructive for growth and financial conditions but tempered by elevated vulnerabilities and pandemic-related uncertainties.
